clips.title: The story
paras: Threat from Below is a defensive mission to purge aggressive naga scouts who are setting up camp nearby. By striking the scout forces and taking their spinefins, adventurers aim to drive the serpentine invaders back north and safeguard the area.

Threat from Below addresses a mounting border disturbance caused by encroaching naga scouts. The serpentine raiders have begun setting up advance camps nearby, prompting local defenders to strike before the intruders can secure a permanent foothold. Adventurers are dispatched to cull the scout forces and return with naga spinefins as proof that the encampment has been crushed.

This is not the first time the serpentfolk have troubled the area, and local command makes it clear that their presence will not be tolerated. Following the strike against their scout camps, the goal is to drive any surviving naga back to the north, leaving vigilant Horde grunts posted to guard against stragglers or sudden ambushes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.
Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hopefully those snake scum aren't giving you trouble?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hopefully that sends them packing back to the north. I'll have some grunts keep an eye out for any stragglers or funny business.
